subject.title: [Feature]: Unify Claude Code / Codex session catalogs into native session UX

question: Should OpenClaw commit now to external catalogs as a first-class native session capability and public plugin API, including zero-config discovery, or first limit the work to internal UI deduplication?
rationale: The choice determines long-lived plugin compatibility, pre-adoption session identity, valid native controls, and setup/security defaults; repository evidence cannot substitute for maintainer product intent.

options.title: Capability-based catalog mode
options.body: Create a public discriminated catalog contract with generic list/read presentation and optional plugin-owned adopt/archive actions, including an explicitly reviewed discovery policy.

options.title: Internal UI deduplication
options.body: Share rows, transcripts, pagination, and refresh components while retaining provider RPCs, plugin-page identity, and current Codex enablement policy.

options.title: Defer the unification
options.body: Keep the newly landed implementations until user evidence or another independent provider further proves the abstraction.

recommendation.title: Capability-based catalog mode
recommendation.body: Create a public discriminated catalog contract with generic list/read presentation and optional plugin-owned adopt/archive actions, including an explicitly reviewed discovery policy.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assignee, proposer, and feature-history owner across both provider catalogs.
